//: Type-aware linting only — never used to build. `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` so they stay out of `dist/`, and `tsconfig.scripts.json` excludes them for the same reason. Both would leave the test files and `vitest.config.ts` outside every project, so typescript-eslint cannot parse them and lint fails with a parsing error rather than reporting anything. This project exists only to give the linter a program that covers them.
